channel.title: Beat the Scam
channel.description: Scam alerts, plain-English checks, and practical guides to help people verify suspicious emails, texts, websites, calls, and offers.

item.title: Cruise Scam UK: Spot Fake Deals and Book Safely
item.description: Cruise scams use fake deals, "free cruise" prizes and bogus booking sites to take your money. How to spot one, book safely and get your money back.

item.title: Holiday Club Scam UK: How to Spot and Avoid Timeshare Fraud
item.description: Holiday club scams push discounted-travel memberships in high-pressure presentations, locking you into costly contracts. How to spot one and get out.

item.title: Timeshare Scam UK: How to Spot and Avoid Holiday Property Traps
item.description: Timeshare scams promise cheap holidays and investment returns, then trap you in contracts with escalating fees. The warning signs and how to get help.

item.title: Fake Travel Agent Scams UK: How to Spot Booking Fraud
item.description: Booking a cheap holiday, flight or villa from an agent you don't know? How to spot a fake travel agent, verify ABTA/ATOL, and protect your money.

item.title: Booking.com Scam UK: Spot a Fake Payment Message
item.description: A message uses real booking details and demands payment or card information. Compare it with the confirmation and contact Booking.com directly.

item.title: HMRC Self Assessment Scam UK: Fake Refund & Tax Bill Texts
item.description: Fake HMRC messages spike around Self Assessment deadlines, claiming a refund or overdue bill. HMRC never asks you to 'confirm' bank details by text.

item.title: Benefits Fraud Text Scam UK: Spot a Fake DWP Text
item.description: Fake DWP texts use benefit reviews or payments to steal personal and bank details. Do not use the link; check through your official benefit account.

item.title: Student Finance Scam UK: Spot a Fake SLC Message
item.description: Fake Student Finance messages ask for personal, login or bank details. Check your online account directly and report suspicious contact.

item.title: Sextortion Email Scam UK: How to Respond Safely
item.description: Sextortion scam emails claim to have compromising footage and demand payment. Learn how to respond, report the email and secure your accounts.

item.title: Email Account Takeover UK: Recover and Lock It Down
item.description: Recover a compromised email account, remove forwarding rules and reused credentials, and use a passkey or two-step verification to secure it.

item.title: Deed Fraud: Protect Property in England and Wales
item.description: Criminals may impersonate an owner to sell or mortgage a property. HM Land Registry offers alerts and title restrictions in England and Wales.

item.title: Identity Theft UK: Warning Signs & What to Do
item.description: Noticed an unrecognised account or a sudden credit-file surprise? Here's how identity theft actually happens in the UK, and what to do about it first.

item.title: Ponzi Scheme UK Warning: Spot the Recruitment Pattern
item.description: A Ponzi scheme pays early investors using later investors' money, not real profit, and cannot be sustained indefinitely. Here's what to watch for.

item.title: Share Fraud UK: Spot a 'Boiler Room' Cold Call
item.description: Cold-called about shares with a free research report thrown in? The FCA's name for this is a 'boiler room' — check before you invest.

item.title: Recovery Room Scam UK: A Second Scam After the First
item.description: Contacted by someone claiming to be the FCA, police, or a solicitor offering to recover money you've already lost? That contact is the scam.

item.title: Wedding Photographer Scam UK: Verify Before You Book
item.description: A portfolio and social profile can be copied. Verify the photographer, contract and payment recipient, and understand card protection before paying.

item.title: Wedding Venue Deposit Scam UK: Verify Before Paying
item.description: Verify a venue and any changed bank details through contact information found independently. Card and bank-transfer protections depend on how the loss occurred.

item.title: Parcel Scam Texts Around Bank Holidays & Christmas
item.description: A 'missed delivery' text arrives after a public holiday or during the Christmas rush? Real delays can make fake parcel texts seem plausible.

item.title: Amazon Scam Phone Calls UK: How to Spot a Fake Amazon Call
item.description: Got an unexpected automated 'Amazon' call about an order or account? Treat it as unverified. Here is how to check it safely and stop a phone scam.

item.title: Chargeback Scam UK: How Chargeback Fraud Works and How to Avoid It
item.description: Chargeback scams let a buyer keep the goods and claim their money back, leaving the seller out of pocket. How chargeback fraud works and how to avoid it.

item.title: Gumtree Scams UK: How to Spot and Avoid Fake Listings and Buyers
item.description: Gumtree is legitimate, but scammers use it. Here are the most common Gumtree scams targeting UK buyers and sellers, the warning signs, and how to stay safe.

item.title: Google Voice Verification Code Scam UK: Don't Share That Code
item.description: Someone asks you to read back a Google verification code to 'prove you're real'? It's a scam to hijack your number. Here's how it works and what to do.

item.title: How to Spot and Avoid Scams in the UK: The Core Rules
item.description: Every scam relies on the same handful of tricks. Learn the pattern once and you'll recognise it in a call, text, or email you've never seen before.

item.title: Driveway Cowboy Scam UK: Spot a Fake Contractor
item.description: An unsolicited caller offers cheap driveway or roof repairs using 'leftover materials'? How to spot a doorstep cowboy trader and report it in the UK.

item.title: Solar Panel Cold Caller Scam UK: Spot the Warning Signs
item.description: Got an unsolicited call or doorstep visit offering free solar panels or a 'government grant'? How to spot a solar panel cold-calling scam in the UK.

item.title: DPD Scam Text or Genuine Message? Check a Fake Delivery Text
item.description: Received a DPD delivery text? Check the parcel independently, distinguish a fake redelivery fee from genuine import charges, and report a scam safely.

item.title: Yodel Scam Text Messages: How to Spot a Fake Yodel Text (UK)
item.description: Fake Yodel texts about a missed parcel or small 'redelivery' fee are smishing scams. How to spot a fake Yodel text, check a real one, and report it.

item.title: UPS Scam Text Messages: Spot a Fake UPS Delivery Text (UK)
item.description: Fake UPS texts about a missed delivery or 'customs fee' are smishing scams. Here's how to spot a fake UPS text, verify a genuine one, and report it in the UK.

item.title: Holiday Compensation Scam UK: Fake Claims Handlers
item.description: Cold-called about compensation you're owed for a delayed or cancelled trip? Check the firm is FCA-authorised before sharing any details.

item.title: Jet2 Holiday Scam UK: Spot a Fake Deal or Contact
item.description: A huge Jet2 discount appeared on WhatsApp or social media? Verify any deal or booking directly on jet2holidays.com before you pay anything.
